# Current UI master strict JFace compile compatibility

This additive proof qualifies the current `hsoliwal/eclipse.platform.ui` source at commit `3db425b5da9f5dafb9d66ae91ef0cae8b271d17a`, root tree `feffe081814943f1a8b3156fb3d32cd7674fe66d`, against the two actual outputs of `m3-eclipse-ui-build-fixes-20261019`. The original 47-file proof remains frozen and continues to describe its original `52f64fe74beb3f8763cefd28651c5d5ab01d5d92` source qualification.

The complete comparison has 161 changed paths and exactly three production JFace changes: `M3ViewerArrays.java`, the new `M3ViewerMap.java`, and `CustomHashtable.java`. Independent readback of the untruncated current JFace subtree (`aed82a677191fac459388dd1fd78f5cd846b7d46`) identifies 424 Java files. Of those, 421 match the original local source bytes; the other three were fetched by exact Git blob identity. The current compiler preferences, TreeViewer preimage, and Commands manifest preimage remain byte-identical to the admitted preimages. `source-scope.json` and the complete source-input manifests record these checks.

Two fresh ECJ compiles ran. The current baseline exited 255 with the expected ten TreeViewer `NonExternalizedStringLiteral` errors and 26 warnings. The candidate compiled all 424 sources, including the three current changes, with exit 0, zero errors, and the same 26 warning identities.
